introHtml: Full color decoration on Moscow mule mugs lets you reproduce complex logos, gradients, or photographic images with vivid accuracy. Unlike single-color engraving or foil stamping, full color printing captures every detail of your brand artwork, making these mugs ideal for event giveaways, brewery promotions, or corporate gifts where visual impact matters. The copper finish provides a bright backdrop that makes colors pop, ensuring your design stands out on bar shelves or office desks.
